name: seasonal-campaign-prep
description: A few weeks before Black Friday, Christmas or any date you pick, chooses the products to feature and drafts the landing-page copy, banner text and a campaign email, ready for your team to review.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: Once a year, a set number of weeks before the occasion

howItWorks.label: Picks
howItWorks.text: The products to feature, from sales, stock and last year's campaign

howItWorks.label: Drafts
howItWorks.text: Landing-page copy, banner text and a campaign email

howItWorks.label: Optional
howItWorks.text: Creates the email as a draft campaign in Klaviyo

howItWorks.label: Asks you
howItWorks.text: Before anything is saved or created in Klaviyo

plugins.reason: Creates the campaign email as a Klaviyo draft for your team to finish and send

data.description: The quantity on hand, so the campaign features what can actually ship
Order line items (product, quantity, date), to find best sellers and last year's occasion sales
Where to save the drafted landing-page copy (a page, collection or campaign record)

parameters.label: Occasion date (month-day)
parameters.description: The usual date, e.g. 11-27; the run works out this year's date for moving occasions

parameters.label: Weeks ahead
parameters.description: How many weeks before the occasion the drafts are prepared

parameters.label: When to run
parameters.description: Once a year, the lead time before the occasion (set up from the two fields above)

parameters.label: The offer
parameters.description: What the campaign promises, e.g. "20% off outerwear" or "free gift wrapping"; the drafts never invent one
